name: Arne Kaiser
bio: Born in Amsterdam, Waldorf-educated in Bergen Norway. Author of 'My Chalkboard' — the definitive guidebook on Waldorf chalkboard art with 400 drawings Grades 1–8. Taught at Geert Groote School Amsterdam and Pine Forest School Flagstaff, Arizona.

name: Narsingh Khalsa
bio: Experienced Waldorf teacher and prolific chalkboard artist. 49,000+ Facebook followers on 'Waldorf Art and Teacher'. Shares chalkboard drawings spanning Grades 1–8, seasonal boards and curriculum-specific content via Instagram @khalsaart and Etsy shop TeachingWaldorf.

name: Nathaniel & Lisa Santa Cruz — Wondergarten
bio: Founded 2022 in Puyallup, Washington. Lisa creates the Wondergarten Curriculum — non-academic, seasonally focused early childhood programme. Nathaniel (former Marine and Google Maps Program Manager) composes original songs and illustrates seasonal chalkboard drawings. Went viral globally.

name: Danijela Zura — @waldorfblackboard
bio: Waldorf teacher and consultant running the @waldorfblackboard Instagram account (23K followers, 1,581 posts). Curates international Waldorf chalkboard drawings from teachers around the world — seasonal, festival and curriculum-specific for all grades. Credits contributing teachers.

name: Steve Simonak
bio: 5th Grade class teacher at Brooklyn Waldorf School. 26 years at Hawthorne Valley Waldorf School. BFA in Painting (Pratt Institute), Waldorf Teaching Certificate (Alkion Center). Teaches annual summer workshop at Sunbridge Institute: 'Techniques and Skills for Creating Beautiful Drawings in the Grades.'

name: Gail Lescher BFA — Prairie Moon Workshops
bio: Waldorf master teacher with BFA. Produced two landmark video workshops for Prairie Moon Waldorf School: 'Chalk Board Drawing Lesson' (100-minute, all skill levels) and 'Advanced Chalkboard Drawings' (full-day, 4+ hours). So well received she was immediately invited back for a second session.

name: Robyn Beaufoy & Brian Wolfe — Waldorfish
bio: Australia-based trained Waldorf teachers with 25+ years in art and education. Online courses for homeschoolers and teachers: Waldorf Art for Beginners, Weekly Art Foundations, Diving Deeper, and Weekly Art and Beyond (32 lessons for high school). Free chalkboard inspiration gallery.

name: Wendy Cook — Anthroposophical Nutrition
bio: Author of 'Foodwise: Understanding What We Eat and How It Affects Us' — the definitive anthroposophical nutrition book. Also: 'The Biodynamic Food & Cookbook' with 150+ seasonal recipes. Studied macrobiotics and Steiner's nutrition approach, later earned Waldorf Education degree at Plymouth University. Taught in clinics, communities and schools.

name: Anne-Marie Fryer Wiboltt
bio: Author of 'Cooking for the Love of the World — Awakening Our Spirituality through Cooking.' A deeply practical and spiritually grounded guide to cooking from an anthroposophical perspective. Covers the grain rhythm, seasonal cooking, preparing food with reverence and the relationship between food and spiritual development.

name: Chenoa Pelligra — @peacewithnaturehandwork
bio: Traveling Waldorf handwork teacher with 18 years experience. Ages 5–adults. Seasonal nature crafts, knitting, felting, weaving. 65K Instagram followers @peacewithnaturehandwork. Founder of peacewithnaturehandwork.com. Featured in Waldorf Handwork Educators conference.

name: Elizabeth Seward PhD & Shellie Smith — WHE
bio: Waldorf Handwork Educators (WHE). Founders of waldorfhandwork.org. Run annual online conferences (February + July), 2-year handwork teacher training programme, and curriculum for homeschoolers. Specialties: knitting, crochet, spinning, weaving, felting, embroidery, sewing. 'Inspiring handwork through the Waldorf lens.'

name: Sophie — Waldorf This Way (@waldorfthisway)
bio: New Zealand-based Waldorf curriculum developer and consultant. Creates Main Lesson Block Guides, the Waldorf Your Way 1:1 programme, and Starpath Learning curriculum. Shares main lesson book work, chalkboard drawings and curriculum planning on Instagram @waldorfthisway. 'hello@waldorfthisway.com'

name: Ashley Renwick — Waldorfy
bio: Podcast host, blogger and Waldorf community builder. 14,700 Instagram followers @waldorfy. Runs an inclusive Waldorf community via waldorfy.com — podcast, blog, mentoring, inclusive approach to Waldorf for diverse families. Known for making Waldorf accessible to all.

name: Melisa & Erik Nielsen — Waldorf Essentials
bio: Waldorf Essentials founders — comprehensive Waldorf homeschool curriculum, podcast and mentoring. 20,300 Instagram followers @waldorfessentials. Authors of temperament parenting resources (free PDF download). waldorfessentials.com — full grades K–8 Waldorf curriculum with coaching.

name: Barbara Braathen — Sophia Circle (@anthroposophylife)
bio: Jacksonville, Florida. Founder of the Sophia Circle — an Anthroposophical Society of America-recognised study group. Part of the Jacksonville Educational Community (JEC) supporting Spring River School (Waldorf-inspired K–12). Activities: monthly study circles, weekly book clubs, Holy Nights Meditations, Elemental Festivals, teacher training with Dr. Torin Finser. Over 500 families reached.

name: Carina Pencet — Waldorf Watercolour Illustrator
bio: Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. Waldorf graduate and watercolour illustrator of fairies, gnomes, elves and seasonal nature beings. 11,000 Instagram followers @illustration.carina.pencet. Author and illustrator of 'Pelle und die Wichteltür' (Bibana Verlag, 2025). Downloadable illustrations and annual calendar at carina-pencet.de

name: Meredith Floyd-Preston — Waldorf at Work (Substack)
bio: Experienced Waldorf class teacher and writer. Substack newsletter 'Waldorf at Work' covering practical classroom art, chalkboard drawing tips, main lesson book titles, hand-lettering strategies and painting by grade. Honest, practical — written from the perspective of a non-artist teacher who developed her skills consciously over years. Includes step-by-step video guides.

name: Viktoriya Vashchenko — Dollbelge
bio: Belgium. 215,000 Instagram followers (@dollbelge). Handcrafts organic Waldorf dolls from organic cotton fabrics, natural wool and beeswax cheeks. 11 years making, 5 years building a global community. Collaborates with Daniela Drescher for exclusive fabrics. DIY kits, tutorials and finished dolls. Every creation includes a signed Certificate of Authenticity.

name: Evi Dolls — Women's Cooperative São Paulo
bio: São Paulo, Brazil. Founded 1988 by Atelier de Bonecas Evi — a small business teaching handicrafts to single mothers from poor families, allowing them to work at home. People with disabilities were later included. Dolls handcrafted from pure cotton and soft wool with mohair or cotton hair. Classic Waldorf-style simple expressions. Available internationally via Nova Natural, Bella Luna Toys, Tree Hollow Toys.

name: Q'ewar Project — Andean Waldorf Cooperative
bio: Andahuaylillas, near Cusco, Peru. Social and economic anthroposophical initiative working with indigenous Quechua women in the rural Andes highlands. Founded 2002 by Waldorf art teacher Julio Herrera and partner Lucy. 47 women + 4 men work daily. Each doll takes 5 days — pure cotton stuffed with sheep wool, alpaca hair, natural dyes, backstrap-loomed ponchos. Also runs Wawa Munakuy preschool.

name: Raduga Grez (Rainbow Dreams)
bio: Russia. The most internationally recognised Russian Waldorf toy brand. Third-generation family carpenters. Handmade wooden stackers, rainbows, arches, animals, gnomes, trees from sustainably sourced solid wood with water-based paints — unvarnished velvet finish, no plywood or glue. Slavic Fairy Tale collection. 117K followers @raduga_grez. Ships worldwide directly.

name: Stardust Concept Store
bio: Netherlands. 'A small, Waldorf-inspired haven run by a dedicated mother and her daughter.' Sustainable children's clothing, wooden toys (Grimm's, Grapat, Glückskäfer and more), Waldorf books, crafts, seasonal decorations and lifestyle items. Everything thoughtfully curated for quality, sustainability and Waldorf values. Worldwide shipping.

name: Centre for Creative Education (CCE)
bio: Plumstead, Cape Town, South Africa. THE primary Waldorf teacher training institution in Africa. Founded 1993. Non-profit. State-accredited by CHE (Council on Higher Education). Qualifications valid in all South African schools. Offers B.Ed Foundation Phase Teaching (4 years, NQF 8) and Level 4 Occupational Certificate in Early Childhood. Also trains teachers for East Africa.

name: FEWB — Federação das Escolas Waldorf do Brasil
bio: São Paulo, Brazil. The Brazilian Federation of Waldorf Schools. Coordinates all 36 schools and 77 kindergartens across Brazil. Supports new initiatives and quality standards. Organises national Waldorf conferences (every two years) and all-Latin America conferences (every three years). First point of contact for anything Waldorf in Brazil.

name: Escola AITIARA — Botucatu Biodynamic Farm School
bio: Botucatu, São Paulo State, Brazil. Founded 1984 on Estância Demetria farm — a biodynamic agricultural estate. One of Brazil's most integrated anthroposophical initiatives, combining Waldorf school, biodynamic farm and community. A model of the living integration of Waldorf education and biodynamic agriculture.

name: Demeter International
bio: The international biodynamic certification and farmers organisation. The Demeter mark on food guarantees biodynamic production to Steiner's original 1924 agricultural indications. demeter.net — worldwide directory of Demeter-certified producers, farms and processors. The gold standard for biodynamic food certification globally.

name: Biodynamic Association USA
bio: Resources, farm directory and education for biodynamic agriculture in North America. Provides a farm locator to find your nearest Demeter-certified biodynamic farm. Hosts conferences, training and supports the growing biodynamic movement across the USA and Canada. biodynamicassociation.org

name: Verlag Freies Geistesleben
bio: Stuttgart, Germany. Founded 1947. One of the leading publishers for anthroposophy and Waldorf education with 1,100+ books and eBooks. Motto: 'Denken mit dem Herzen' (Thinking with the Heart). Subjects: Waldorf pedagogy, anthroposophy, children's and young adult books, cookbooks, creative guides. The primary German-language Waldorf publisher.

name: erziehungsKUNST Magazine
bio: Stuttgart (Verlag Urachhaus). The flagship German-language Waldorf education magazine. Published monthly. Provides insight into Waldorf pedagogy, articles for better understanding of children and young people, dialogue with partners and critics, forum for parents, reviews of educational books. Climate-neutral production. Instagram: @erziehungskunst · erziehungskunst.de

name: Waldorfshop.eu — Europe
bio: Germany. The largest online Waldorf shop in Europe — comprehensive range of Stockmar art supplies, Choroi instruments, natural toys, wool, beeswax, seasonal craft materials, pedagogical books and Waldorf school supplies. Works in cooperation with Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen. B2B programme for schools and kindergartens. Ships throughout Europe.

name: Stockmar — Wax Crayons & Paints
bio: Celle, Lower Saxony, Germany. Founded 1931. The world's most loved Waldorf art supply brand — beeswax block crayons, stick crayons, watercolour paints, finger paints and modelling beeswax. Made in Germany from beeswax and natural pigments. Stockmar block crayons are the standard for Waldorf chalkboard drawing and children's art. Available worldwide.

name: Choroi Instrumente
bio: Stuttgart, Germany. Founded in collaboration with the Goetheanum Medical Section. The world's primary maker of Waldorf musical instruments — pentatonic flutes (pear/cherry wood), lyres, harps, glockenspiels and diatonic flutes. Choroi instruments are designed to support child development. Workshops employ people with disabilities. choroi.org

name: Filges — Natural Wool & Felt
bio: Heidelberg, Germany. Germany's premier manufacturer of natural wool products for Waldorf education — plant-dyed fairy tale wool, wool batting, felt sheets, felting wool, wool padding and birthday crown material. Used in Waldorf kindergartens and schools throughout Germany and worldwide. filges.de

name: Threefold Educational Foundation
bio: Chestnut Ridge, New York. 'An anthroposophical community of people working in service to Waldorf education, biodynamics, the arts, spirituality, and social life.' Stewards a 140-acre campus in the Hudson Valley. Home to: Green Meadow Waldorf School, Sunbridge Institute, Eurythmy Spring Valley, Otto Specht School (curative), Threefold Community Farm (biodynamic), The Fellowship Community, Threefold Café, Hungry Hollow Co-op, Fiber Craft Studio. Established 1926.

name: Reg Down — Tiptoes Lightly Series
bio: Canada / South Africa. Author of the Tiptoes Lightly Series — humorous, innocent, sanguine nature tales tested in real Waldorf kindergartens for decades. Characters include Tiptoes the fairy, Pine Cone & Pepper Pot the gnomes, and Farmer John. Ages 3–7 for read-aloud. 230+ free stories available at tiptoes-lightly.net

name: Susan Perrow MEd — Therapeutic Storytelling
bio: Australia. Therapeutic storytelling for challenging behaviour and difficult situations. Online training; individual mentoring; books translated into 10+ languages. Author: 'Healing Stories for Challenging Behaviour', 'Therapeutic Storytelling: 101 Healing Stories for Children', 'Stories to Light the Night'. susanperrow.com

name: Robyn M. Brown — Mulberry Classroom / Curative Education
bio: USA. Founder of Mulberry Classroom at Poppy Hill Center, California. Curative education training, mentoring and workshops internationally. Author: 'A Practical Guide to Curative Education: The Ladder of the Seven Life Processes' (440 pages, Lindisfarne Books). Small mixed-age classrooms (max 8 students). Full Waldorf curriculum with curative lens.

name: Patti Connolly — Student Support & Remedial
bio: USA. Student Support Teacher (Early Childhood–Grade 3); remedial specialist with 30+ years experience. Currently at Waldorf School of the Roaring Fork, Colorado. Mentors Kindergarten–4th Grade teachers. Associated with Waldorf Inspirations (waldorfinspirations.com) — one of the longest-serving Waldorf remedial practitioners in the USA.

name: Gnomes & Acorns — Canada
bio: Canada. Waldorf-inspired online store with an ethical heart. Toys from Women's Cooperatives in Brazil, Romania and Nepal. Wooden toys from Germany. Mercurius Canada art and music supplies. Weleda health care. Curates with the motto: 'SEE BEAUTY. CREATE ART. LOVE READING. SUSTAIN NATURE.' Ships across Canada and internationally.

name: Sienna Academy — Anthroposophical Art Therapy
bio: Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia. Art therapy training and individual painting sessions. Uses the Anthroposophical Liane Collot d'Herbois painting therapy approach — iARTe recognised. Offers therapeutic painting for development, healing and self-discovery in the anthroposophical tradition.

name: Freie Waldorfschule Uhlandshöhe — Stuttgart
bio: Stuttgart, Germany. The first Waldorf school in the world — founded 7 September 1919 by Rudolf Steiner at the request of Emil Molt. Still operating today at the same Uhlandshöhe address. The original school building, designed with Steiner's input, still stands. A living monument to the beginning of a global education movement of 1,100+ schools in 60+ countries.

name: Waldorf Publications / AWSNA
bio: Association of Waldorf Schools of North America. Publisher of Waldorf educational materials, curriculum books, research publications and teacher resources for the North American Waldorf movement. Primary source for English-language curriculum documentation, teacher education texts and conference proceedings. waldorfpublications.org

name: Henning Köhler — Curative Education Author
bio: Germany. Author of 'Working with Anxious, Nervous and Depressed Children' and 'The Inner Life of the Earth'. Curative educator and anthroposophical psychotherapist. Works translated into many languages. Practical tools for parents and teachers navigating children's emotional difficulties from an anthroposophic perspective. Published by AWSNA and Floris Books.

name: Annie Haas — @thechildisthecurriculum
bio: USA. Waldorf homeschool mother of three. Instagram account @thechildisthecurriculum featuring seasonal tables, anthroposophy in daily life, and hands-on lesson activities. Known for beautifully photographed seasonal nature tables, homeschool room setups and practical Waldorf home education ideas that are accessible for everyday families.

name: Warrah — Anthroposophic Community Farm
bio: Sydney, NSW, Australia. Non-profit supporting individuals with intellectual disability to live engaging, purposeful lives. Operates a biodynamic farm with day and residential programmes. One of Australia's leading Camphill-inspired communities integrating biodynamic agriculture, Waldorf-inspired therapies and meaningful daily work. warrah.org.au

name: Weleda AG — Biodynamic Medicinal Garden
bio: International (founded Arlesheim, Switzerland, 1921). Anthroposophic medicines and biodynamic skincare. Maintains a biodynamic medicinal plant garden since 1921. Products use biodynamically grown ingredients. One of the world's leading natural medicine and cosmetics manufacturers. Global distribution. Key resource for anthroposophic families and practitioners. weleda.com

name: Social Project Monte Azul
bio: São Paulo, Brazil. Long-running anthroposophical social project serving children from favela communities. Includes multiple kindergartens and a Waldorf school. Award-winning social integration project. Part of Brazil's network of 38 Social Waldorf institutions serving over 5,000 children and youth in socioeconomic vulnerability. name: ⭐ Quintenlieder — Music for Young Children in the Mood of the Fifth

name: Merrily We Sing — Original Songs in the Mood of the Fifth

name: ⭐ Shepherd's Songbook — Grades 1, 2 and 3

name: One for the Golden Sun — Pentatonic Songs

name: ⭐ Dancing As We Sing

name: Let Us Form a Ring

name: ⭐ Singing Games for Families, Schools and Communities

name: Gesture Games for Spring & Summer / Autumn & Winter

name: AnthroWiki — Calendar of the Soul
bio: en.anthro.wiki/Calendar_of_the_Soul · Comprehensive encyclopaedia article on the structure, history and practice of the Calendar of the Soul. Includes references to all major translations and secondary literature. Free.

name: Das Goetheanum — Research on the Calendar of the Soul
bio: dasgoetheanum.com · Research articles on working with the mirror verse and counter verse. For deeper study after one has worked with the verses for a year or more. Free online articles.

name: Rudolf Steiner Institute — Calendar Resources

name: Education for Special Needs (Curative Education Course)
bio: Rudolf Steiner. 12 lectures from 1924. The foundational text. Every curative educator begins here. Available free online via rsarchive.org; in print via Rudolf Steiner Press.

name: A Practical Guide to Curative Education: The Ladder of the Seven Life Processes
bio: Robyn M. Brown. 440 pages. The most accessible, practical modern guide to Steiner's curative education. For both parents and teachers. "A much-needed reminder of a tried-and-tested approach that can work for every child."

name: Healing Stories for Challenging Behaviour

bio: The most comprehensive free online Waldorf handwork curriculum reference. Detailed pedagogical descriptions for every grade from 1 through 12, including high school. waldorf-resources.org/en/vertical-curriculum/handwork-and-crafts

name: Waldorf Inspirations — Handwork Resources (Free)
bio: Janet Langley and team. Free handwork project ideas, patterns and curriculum notes for all grades at waldorfinspirations.com. Including chalkboard-linked handwork project ideas.

name: The Warp and Weft — Elizabeth Seward (Waldorfish blog)
bio: Free article by Elizabeth Seward PhD on the full arc of the Waldorf handwork curriculum — how knitting connects to maths, music, visual arts and main lesson across all grades. waldorfish.com/blog/handworkcurriculum

name: Knit for Health and Wellness — Betsan Corkhill
bio: The research-based book on knitting's measurable physical and mental health benefits. Used in WHE conferences. Confirms from a neuroscience perspective what Waldorf education has practised for 100 years. knitforlife.com

name: Earthschooling — Woodworking with Kids and Handwork Units
bio: USA. Digital lesson plans including handwork projects for multiple grades, with stories, verses and step-by-step guidance. earthschooling.info

name: Gathering Waters Charter School — The Role of Handwork in Development (Free article)
bio: A beautifully written free article on the developmental case for handwork in Waldorf education — head, heart and hands. gatheringwaterscharter.org/insights/handwork-in-waldorf-education

name: ⭐ Franziska Shelton — My Seasonal Treasury (Germany)
bio: Germany. Creator of My Seasonal Treasury — a beloved Waldorf-inspired seasonal resource site offering beautifully crafted tutorials, printable resources, crafting ideas and seasonal guides for families and educators. Tutorials include: wet-on-wet watercolour painting, natur

name: ⭐ Lydia Schade-Fox — Filzkunst (Germany) · 68K Instagram
bio: Germany. Felt artist, author and creative business expert. 68K followers on Instagram. Offers: FilzClub (membership community for felt artists), DIY felting kits and online felting courses. Known for exquisite Waldorf-inspired felt figures — gnomes, elves, forest fa

name: Tiny Wooly Worlds — Felted Playmats (@tiny_wooly_worlds)
bio: Handmade wet-felted wool playmats and nature table pieces in the Waldorf tradition. 100% natural merino wool — made entirely by hand using only water and soap. Playscapes with 3D elements — ponds, streams, tree stumps, flowers, mushrooms, woodland features. Felted animals, gnomes and fairies availab

name: Weir Crafts ⭐
bio: USA. Founded by Susan Weir to fund her children's Waldorf school fees. THE #1 doll-making supply shop in North America since 1989. USA-made doll skin fabric, 100% wool felt, merino wool roving, felting kits, Filges wool, DollyMo mohair hair yarn, organic cotton batting, felting needles. Ships intern

name: A Child's Dream ⭐
bio: USA. Pure wool felt sheets, organic wool batting for doll stuffing and crown padding, wool roving for felting, natural dyed silk and cotton. Complete handwork supply shop used by Waldorf schools worldwide. Knitting supplies, crochet hooks, embroidery floss, weaving materials.

name: The Felting Source
bio: USA. Specialist felting supplier catering directly to Waldorf schools. Excellent quality fibres at fair prices. Texel plant-dyed wool from Germany for wool painting. New Zealand prefelt sheets (10 × 10 inch). FeltCraft kits for wet and needle felting. Also wholesale to Waldorf school stores.

name: Living Felt / Holland Felt
bio: USA. Comprehensive needle felting and wet felting supplier. Merino wool roving, core wool, wool felt sheets (Holland Felt — 100% pure wool). Large range of colours. Specialist felting equipment and tools. Good for birthday crown projects.

name: Paper Scissors Stone / Waldorf Supplies
bio: USA. Blended Merino wool roving in 17 colours. Felting kits, embroidery, seasonal Waldorf craft supplies. Class sets available for school purchase. waldorfsupplies.com

name: Alder & Alouette
bio: USA. Largest US stockist of Filges wool (full range of fairy tale wool, merino wool, yarn bundles, felt sheets). Also instruments, curriculum books, Waldorf supplies. Ships internationally.

name: Blue Otter Toys
bio: USA. Filges organic wool stockist. Plant-dyed Filges fibres for Waldorf handwork and felting. blueottertoys.com

name: Maplerose ⭐
bio: British Columbia, Canada. Run by Jenn from the Nelson Waldorf School community. 100% wool felt sheets (full range of colours, available by the sheet or by the meter on special order), heathered natural wool felt, seasonal felt sets (spring, summer, autumn, winter), 100% Canadian beeswax, doll-making

name: Nest
bio: Canada. Filges wool stockist. Natural and plant-dyed wool. Handwork supplies including Waldorf-appropriate tools and materials. nest.ca

name: Fibrecraft
bio: Canada. Wool roving, silk fibres, felting needles and supplies for needle felting and wet felting. Quality materials for fibre artists. Fast Canadian shipping. fibrecraft.ca

name: Canadian Felt Shop
bio: Canada. 100% wool felt, wool blend felt, wool roving, wool felt balls. Ships to USA via USPS. Comprehensive selection.

name: Real Wool Shop
bio: Canada. Yarns, knitting supplies, roving and felting supplies. Wool, merino, alpaca, silk, mohair. Specialty items and natural fibre range.

name: Filges (direct) ⭐
bio: Germany. The source. Bioland-certified plant-dyed wool manufacturer since 1985. Order directly or via waldorfshop.eu for best range. filges.de

name: Waldorfshop EU ⭐
bio: Ireland / EU. Full Filges range: felting wool, knitting yarn, felt sheets, fairy tale wool, weaving yarn, silk cloths, tools. Also Stockmar art supplies, instruments, toys. Ships throughout EU and UK. Large professional range.

name: Teia Education & Play
bio: Switzerland. Filges wool and broader Waldorf handwork range. Ships EU and internationally. teiaeducation.ch

name: ⭐ Stardust Concept Store — Netherlands
bio: Netherlands. "A small, Waldorf-inspired haven run by a dedicated mother and her daughter." EU. Filges plant-dyed wool including fairy tale wool, felt sheets and felting supplies — plus wooden toys, Waldorf books, sustainable clothing, seasonal decorations, crafts, lifestyle items and Waldor

name: MamaOwl
bio: Netherlands. Waldorf-inspired online store. Natural fibre handwork supplies including wool felt, roving and knitting materials. Ships EU-wide. mamaowl.net

name: Myriad Natural Toys & Crafts
bio: UK. Natural fibre craft supplies alongside toys. Wool felting kits, roving and handwork materials. Family-run since 1998. myriadonline.co.uk

name: Waldorfshop EU
bio: Ships to UK. Full Filges range available with reasonable shipping costs. waldorfshop.eu

name: Oskar's Wooden Ark
bio: Australia. Carries Filges and other natural wool handwork supplies alongside Waldorf toys. oskars.com.au

name: Tara Treasures
bio: Australia. Felt play mats and ethically handmade felt products. Also supplies some raw wool craft materials. taratreasures.com

name: Woolly Felters (NZ)
bio: New Zealand. Wool roving, felting supplies, wool felt sheets. NZ-based felting specialist. Good range of natural fibres.

name: The Wool Inn (NZ)
bio: New Zealand. Merino wool roving, felt and natural fibre supplies. NZ Merino is world-class quality — excellent for felting and Waldorf handwork.

name: Natural Dye Studio (NZ)
bio: New Zealand. Plant-dyed wool rovings and yarns. High-quality natural fibres. Compatible with Waldorf handwork requirements.

name: Wool & the Gang / local yarn shops
bio: South Africa has excellent local wool producers (Merino, Rambouillet, and Corriedale sheep farming is significant in SA). Search for local yarn shops in Cape Town and Johannesburg. Ask at Waldorf school craft markets for local wool suppliers known to the community.

name: YarnLove South Africa
bio: South African online yarn shop. Natural fibres including wool and wool blends for knitting and crochet. Handwork supplies.

name: Import via Weir Crafts or A Child's Dream
bio: USA suppliers ship internationally to South Africa. For Filges products specifically: waldorfshop.eu ships worldwide and is often the most cost-effective route for SA buyers.

name: ⭐ 1. Theosophy: An Introduction to the Spiritual Processes in Human Life and in the Cosmos (GA 9)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1904. The most accessible entry point into Steiner's worldview. Introduces the fourfold human being (physical body, etheric body, astral body, ego), reincarnation, karma, and the soul's journey after death. Short, relatively clear, and beautifully structured. Start here. Available fr

name: ⭐ 2. How to Know Higher Worlds / Knowledge of the Higher Worlds (GA 10)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1904. Steiner's fundamental handbook for spiritual and personal development. Practical manual of exercises, stages of inner training, protective practices and grounding. Guidance on developing clairvoyant perception while maintaining intellectual rigour and psychological balance. The

name: ⭐ 3. An Outline of Esoteric Science (Occult Science — an Outline) (GA 13)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1910. Of all Steiner's books this one perhaps comes closest to containing the whole of his spiritual teaching. Systematic presentation of his cosmology, the constitution of the human being, the evolution of the earth and humanity through cosmic stages, reincarnation and karma in dept

name: ⭐ 4. The Philosophy of Freedom / Intuitive Thinking as a Spiritual Path (GA 4)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1894. Steiner's clearest statement of epistemology, moral autonomy and the method of intuitive thinking. The philosophical foundation of everything that follows. Argues that true freedom lies not in the absence of constraint but in the capacity to act from pure thinking — from love f

name: Christianity as a Mystical Fact (GA 8)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1902. Steiner's exploration of the Christ event as the central mystery of human evolution — seen not through faith but through spiritual-scientific investigation. Bridges ancient mystery traditions and the significance of the Resurrection for human consciousness. Rudolf Steiner Press

name: Stages of Higher Knowledge (GA 12)
bio: Rudolf Steiner. The companion to Knowledge of Higher Worlds — on the three stages of higher cognition: imagination, inspiration and intuition. A deeper exploration of what the spiritual organs of perception actually are. SteinerBooks.

name: The Foundation Stone Meditation
bio: Rudolf Steiner, Christmas Conference 1923. The spiritual cornerstone of the re-founded Society. A meditation verse in four parts — one for each season — encompassing the whole of anthroposophy in concentrated poetic form. Read alongside an explanation (many available) — the deepest single meditation

name: Anthroposophical Leading Thoughts (GA 26)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1924–1925. Written in the final year of his life — letters to members including the Michael Letters and the cosmic thinking of humanity's last spiritual turning. Advanced but profoundly rewarding. Available free at rsarchive.org.

name: The Calendar of the Soul (GA 40)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1912. The 52 weekly meditation verses — one for each week of the year beginning at Easter. A living companion to the whole year. Read alongside the live verse widget in this directory. Available free at rsarchive.org/COTS. SteinerBooks print edition ISBN 0-88010-263-2.

name: ⭐ The Education of the Child (GA 34)
bio: Rudolf Steiner. The foundational essay on Waldorf education — short, accessible, essential. Covers the three seven-year developmental stages, the relationship between education and soul-spiritual development, and the principles of the Waldorf curriculum. The ideal first Steiner education text. Avail

name: Study of Man / Foundations of Human Experience (GA 293)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1919. The foundational lectures given to the first Waldorf teachers before the school opened. The deepest account of child development and the nature of the threefold human being in relation to education. Essential for any serious Waldorf teacher or parent. SteinerBooks / Anthroposop

name: Agriculture Course (GA 327)
bio: Rudolf Steiner, 1924. The foundational lectures on biodynamic agriculture given at Koberwitz. Eight lectures. The indispensable text for understanding biodynamic farming — see the Biodynamic Agriculture section of this directory. Available free at rsarchive.org. SteinerBooks / Floris Books.

name: Nutrition: Food, Health and Spiritual Development
bio: Rudolf Steiner (ed. Christian von Arnim). Anthology of Steiner's lectures on nutrition — impact of vegetarian and meat diets, proteins, fats, carbohydrates, individual foods. The philosophical foundation for Waldorf nutrition. SteinerBooks. Also: see the Nutrition section of this directory.

name: ⭐ Rudolf Steiner: An Introduction to His Life and Work — Gary Lachman
bio: TarcherPerigee. The most readable and accessible biography of Rudolf Steiner by respected esoteric historian Gary Lachman (formerly Gary Valentine of Blondie). Places Steiner in the context of Western esoteric history. Ideal first book for anyone approaching Steiner from outside the movement. Non-pa

name: The Way of Anthroposophy — Florin Lowndes
bio: Floris Books. Clear, accessible introduction to the core ideas of anthroposophy for newcomers. Covers the fourfold human being, reincarnation, karma, the spiritual world and inner development. Recommended for families approaching anthroposophy through Waldorf education.

name: Rudolf Steiner: Herald of a New Epoch — Stewart Easton
bio: Anthroposophic Press. Classic comprehensive biography of Rudolf Steiner. More detailed and sympathetic than Lachman — written from within the movement. SteinerBooks.

name: Toward Imagination: Culture and the Individual — Yeshayahu Ben-Aharon
bio: Anthroposophic Press. For more advanced students — on the development of imagination as a cognitive and spiritual faculty. One of the most important contemporary anthroposophical thinkers.

name: ⭐ Rudolf Steiner Archive (rsarchive.org)
bio: The most important free online resource in the anthroposophical world. The complete digital archive of Rudolf Steiner's written works and lecture cycles — over 6,000 lectures in English translation. Searchable by GA number, keyword or topic. Free. The Calendar of the Soul tool (rsarchive.org/COTS) i

name: ⭐ AnthroWiki (en.anthro.wiki)
bio: The anthroposophical encyclopaedia — comprehensive articles on all aspects of Steiner's work, the Society's history, key concepts, personalities and practical fields. In German and English. One of the best research tools for serious students. en.anthro.wiki

name: Das Goetheanum Online (dasgoetheanum.com)
bio: The Goetheanum's journal — weekly content on anthroposophy, Waldorf education, biodynamic farming, the arts, social questions and the Goetheanum's own life. In German with selected English content. Free articles and research essays. dasgoetheanum.com

name: Goetheanum Lectures Online
bio: The Goetheanum regularly livestreams lectures, performances and events from Dornach. Free to watch worldwide. Check the Goetheanum events calendar at goetheanum.ch for upcoming lectures.

name: Online Waldorf Library (waldorflibrary.org)
bio: Free digital library of Waldorf education materials — articles, curriculum guides, lectures on education, research papers. Maintained by the Research Institute for Waldorf Education. waldorflibrary.org

name: SteinerBooks / Anthroposophic Press (steinerbooks.org)
bio: USA. The primary English-language publisher of Steiner's works and anthroposophical titles. Full catalogue, new releases, digital editions. steinerbooks.org · Also: the Rudolf Steiner Bookstore at rudolfsteinerbookstore.com

name: Rudolf Steiner Press / Sophia Books (UK)
bio: UK. The primary British publisher of Steiner's works and anthroposophical literature. Classic translations. rudolfsteinerpress.com

name: Camphill Movement
bio: An international network of communities for people with developmental disabilities, founded on anthroposophical principles by Karl König in 1940. Camphill communities combine residential care, Waldorf education, biodynamic farming and artistic activity in a therapeutic social environment. Over 100 c

name: ⭐ Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen (BdFWS)
bio: Stuttgart & Berlin. The umbrella organisation of all Waldorf schools in Germany — over 250 schools and 600+ kindergartens. "Waldorf" and "Rudolf Steiner" are registered trademarks of the Bund. School finder, teacher training seminars directory, publications, podcasts (Waldorf.Perspektiven), job list

name: Bundesverband der Rudolf Steiner Schulen in Deutschland
bio: The second German Waldorf school association — schools that use the name "Rudolf Steiner Schule" rather than "Waldorf School." Both associations are fully recognised. Works in close cooperation with the Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen.

name: Vereinigung der Waldorfkindergärten Deutschland
bio: Association of Waldorf Kindergartens in Germany. Over 600 member kindergartens. Mentoring, training support, quality development, publications. A growing movement — Germany needs many new Waldorf kindergartens and teachers as demand continues to rise. waldorfkindergarten.de

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst Rudolf Steiners
bio: International aid organisation for Waldorf education worldwide — headquartered in Germany. Collects donations and passes 100% (without deducting administration costs) to Waldorf projects abroad — supporting Waldorf school development in Eastern Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America. freunde-waldorf

name: Pädagogische Forschungsstelle beim Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen
bio: Stuttgart. The research institute of the German Waldorf school movement. Research on Waldorf pedagogy, curriculum, child development and school quality. Publications, conference proceedings and the comprehensive links network for Waldorf institutions worldwide. forschung-waldorf.de

name: ⭐ Freie Hochschule Stuttgart — Seminar für Waldorfpädagogik
bio: Stuttgart. The primary full-time Waldorf teacher training institution in Germany — located steps from the first Waldorf school on the Uhlandshöhe. Bachelor's and Master's programmes in Waldorf education. The most historically significant Waldorf teacher training institution in the world. freie-hochs

name: ⭐ Alanus Hochschule für Kunst und Gesellschaft — Waldorf Institute
bio: Alfter bei Bonn (near Cologne). State-recognised university of art and society with a strong Waldorf education faculty. Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Waldorf education, curative education, artistic therapies, fine art, music, theatre and social work. One of the most internationally known German

name: Waldorf-Ideen-Pool ⭐ FREE — Marcus Kraneburg
bio: Germany. Marcus Kraneburg's extraordinarily generous free teacher resource site — hundreds of lesson plans, main lesson book examples, teaching materials, craft ideas and pedagogical articles in German. One of the richest free Waldorf teaching resources in the German-speaking world. Used by teachers

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst — Fortbildungen
bio: Germany / International. The Freunde der Erziehungskunst offers professional development courses, workshops and seminars for Waldorf teachers. Also coordinates volunteer teacher exchanges worldwide — sending experienced German Waldorf teachers to developing Waldorf movements. freunde-waldorf.de/fort

name: ⭐ Verlag Freies Geistesleben — Stuttgart
bio: Stuttgart. Founded 1947 on the initiative of the Free Waldorf School of Stuttgart and the Anthroposophical Society of Stuttgart. One of the leading publishers for anthroposophy and Waldorf education — 1,100+ available books and eBooks. Motto: "Denken mit dem Herzen" (Thinking with the Heart

name: ⭐ Verlag Urachhaus — Stuttgart
bio: Stuttgart. Founded 1925. Merged with Verlag Freies Geistesleben in the 1990s but continues as an independent imprint. Focus: children's and young adult books, literature, gift books, medicine, pedagogy, religious renewal and cultural history. Publisher of the erziehungsKUNST magazine. Belov

name: ⭐ erziehungsKUNST — Magazine (Monthly)
bio: Stuttgart (Verlag Urachhaus). The flagship German-language Waldorf education magazine. Published monthly. Provides insight into the motives of Waldorf pedagogy, articles for better understanding of children and young people, dialogue with partners and critics, a forum for parents, reviews of educati

name: Rudolf Steiner Verlag — Basel, Switzerland (German editions)
bio: Basel, Switzerland. The primary publisher of Rudolf Steiner's complete works in German (the Gesamtausgabe — GA). All of Steiner's lectures and books in their original German. The definitive scholarly editions. rudolf-steiner-verlag.ch

name: Verlag am Goetheanum — Dornach, Switzerland
bio: Dornach. Publisher for anthroposophical literature from the Goetheanum. Science, arts, social renewal, education and anthroposophy. Close connection to the Goetheanum's various sections and the General Anthroposophical Society. vergam.ch

name: J. Ch. Mellinger Verlag — Stuttgart
bio: Stuttgart. Anthroposophical publisher in Stuttgart — specialising in texts on spiritual science, social renewal and Waldorf education. One of the smaller specialist publishers in the Stuttgart anthroposophical network.

name: Futurum Verlag — Basel
bio: Basel, Switzerland. Publisher of books describing seeds for future-oriented social design — without fixed doctrine, enabling dialogue and discourse. Connected to the anthroposophical impulse of social renewal.

name: Das Goetheanum — Weekly Journal
bio: Dornach, Switzerland. The international weekly journal of the General Anthroposophical Society — the most important anthroposophical journal in German. Articles on anthroposophy, Waldorf education, biodynamic farming, arts, social questions, festivals and the life of the Goetheanum. dasgoetheanum.co

name: ⭐ GAÄD — Gesellschaft Anthroposophischer Ärzte in Deutschland
bio: Germany. The German Society of Anthroposophical Doctors — the primary professional association for anthroposophic physicians in Germany and German-speaking countries. Doctor finder, publications, research, continuing education for doctors, nurses and therapists. The largest national anthroposophic m

name: ⭐ Weleda AG — Schwäbisch Gmünd, Germany & Arlesheim, Switzerland
bio: Founded 1921 alongside the first Waldorf school. Germany's headquarters in Schwäbisch Gmünd — with a biodynamic medicinal plant garden. The world's leading manufacturer of anthroposophic medicines and natural cosmetics. Products include Arnica massage oil, Calendula baby care, Birch Arnica bath milk

name: ⭐ WALA Heilmittel GmbH — Bad Boll/Eckwälden, Germany
bio: Bad Boll, Baden-Württemberg. Founded 1935 by Dr. Rudolf Hauschka in the anthroposophical tradition. Manufacturer of Dr. Hauschka skin care and WALA medicinal preparations. WALA's 12-hectare biodynamic garden grows over 250 medicinal plant varieties. Dr. Hauschka products available worldwide. wala.de

name: Gemeinschaftskrankenhaus Herdecke
bio: Herdecke, North Rhine-Westphalia. The flagship anthroposophic hospital in Germany — one of the most significant anthroposophic medical institutions in the world. Acute care hospital integrating conventional and anthroposophic medicine. University teaching hospital connected to Witten/Herdecke Univer

name: Gemeinschaftskrankenhaus Havelhöhe — Berlin
bio: Berlin. Anthroposophic hospital in Berlin. Acute care, oncology, psychiatry and outpatient services. One of the key anthroposophic medical centres in northern Germany. havelhoehe.de

name: ARCANA Arzneimittel — Munich
bio: Munich. Manufacturer of anthroposophic medicines — one of several smaller German manufacturers of Steiner-inspired medicinal preparations alongside Weleda and WALA. arcana.de

name: Witten/Herdecke University — Faculty of Health
bio: Witten. Germany's first private university — founded on the initiative of the anthroposophical movement. Faculty of Health includes the Department of Anthroposophic Medicine and integrative medicine research. Internationally recognised for innovative medical education. uni-wh.de

name: ⭐ Demeter Deutschland e.V.
bio: Darmstadt. Germany has one of the largest and most active biodynamic farming movements in the world — hundreds of Demeter-certified farms, dairies, bakeries, wineries and food producers. Farm and product finder: demeter.de — search by postcode and product type. The most comprehensive national biodyn

name: Rapunzel Naturkost — Legau, Allgäu
bio: Legau, Bavaria. One of Germany's most beloved organic and biodynamic food brands. Founded 1974 in the spirit of ecological and social renewal. Wide range of organic whole foods — nuts, dried fruits, grains, pastas, chocolate. Many products Demeter-certified. Available throughout Germany and internat

name: Alnatura — Darmstadt
bio: Darmstadt. Germany's leading organic supermarket chain — co-founded in the anthroposophical spirit. 140+ stores across Germany. Strong Demeter-certified product range. Alnatura products available in Swiss Migros and other retailers. Close cultural connection to Waldorf families. alnatura.de

name: Forschungsring für Biologisch-Dynamische Wirtschaftsweise e.V.
bio: Darmstadt. The German biodynamic research institute. Research on biodynamic farming methods, preparations, farm organism, soil biology and food quality. Publications and annual research reports. forschungsring.de

name: ⭐ Waldorfshop.eu — Waldorf Shop Europe
bio: Germany. The largest online Waldorf shop in Europe — comprehensive range of Stockmar art supplies, Choroi instruments, natural toys, wool, beeswax, seasonal craft materials, pedagogical books and Waldorf school supplies. Works in cooperation with the Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen and Freunde der Er

name: ⭐ Stockmar — Wax Crayons & Paints (Celle, Germany)
bio: Celle, Lower Saxony. Founded 1931. The world's most loved Waldorf art supply brand — beeswax block crayons, beeswax stick crayons, watercolour paints, finger paints and modelling beeswax. Made in Germany from beeswax and natural pigments. Stockmar block crayons are the standard for Waldorf chalkboar

name: ⭐ Choroi Instrumente — Stuttgart
bio: Stuttgart. Founded in collaboration with the Goetheanum Medical Section. The world's primary maker of Waldorf musical instruments — pentatonic flutes (pear/cherry wood), lyres, harps, glockenspiels and diatonic flutes. Choroi instruments are designed to support child development. Workshops employ pe

name: Mercurius — Waldorf Art Supplies (Netherlands/Germany)
bio: Netherlands (distributed throughout German-speaking Europe). Manufacturer of Waldorf block chalk, coloured pencils, watercolours and art papers. Widely used in German Waldorf schools alongside Stockmar. Available at waldorfshop.eu and specialist suppliers.

name: Filges — Natural Wool & Felt (Heidelberg)
bio: Heidelberg. Germany's premier manufacturer of natural wool products for Waldorf education — plant-dyed fairy tale wool, wool batting, felt sheets, felting wool, wool padding and birthday crown material. Used in Waldorf kindergartens and schools throughout Germany and worldwide. filges.de · Available

name: ⭐ Editora Antroposófica (Brazil)
bio: São Paulo, Brazil. The leading Brazilian publisher of anthroposophical and Waldorf books in Portuguese. Steiner's collected works, Waldorf pedagogy, biography and spiritual science translated into Portuguese. editora.com.br

name: Instituto Biodinâmico — IBD (Brazil)
bio: Brazil. The main biodynamic certification body in South America. Deeply connected to the anthroposophical and Waldorf agricultural movement. ibd.com.br

name: ⭐ Editorial Antroposófica (Argentina)
bio: Buenos Aires, Argentina. The primary Argentine publisher and bookshop for anthroposophical and Waldorf education books in Spanish. Full online store covering all categories: Educación Waldorf, Antroposofía, Medicina, Literatura Infantil, Agricultura Biodinámica, Pedagogía Curativa, Euritmia and more

name: Editorial Rudolf Steiner (Spain)
bio: Spain. Founded 1975 — the longest-running Spanish-language anthroposophical publisher. Rudolf Steiner's foundational works, Waldorf education, biodynamics, medicine, Christology and social science in Spanish. Serves the entire Spanish-speaking world. editorialrudolfsteiner.com

name: Editorial Pau de Damasc (Spain)
bio: Spain. A major Spanish-language anthroposophical publisher serving Spain and Latin America. Waldorf pedagogy, anthroposophy, Goethean science, curative education, eurythmy, children's stories and school materials in Spanish and Catalan. paudedamasc.com

name: Editorial Idunn (Chile)
bio: Chile. Chilean publisher of Waldorf and anthroposophical books in Spanish. Part of the growing Latin American Waldorf publishing network serving Chile, Argentina and beyond.

name: Latin American Waldorf Conference (triennial)
bio: All-Latin America conference for Waldorf educators, held every three years. Rotating host country. Organised by FEWB (Brazil) in coordination with national federations. The flagship gathering of the Latin American Waldorf movement.

name: IPMT — International Postgraduate Medical Training (Latin America)
bio: The IPMT was initiated in 2002 by Dr. Michaela Glöckler and the Medical Section at Goetheanum. Annual course weeks for physicians and licensed prescribers in AM — available across Latin America. Main countries offering or accessing IPMT: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Uruguay. Co

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst (Friends of Waldorf Education)
bio: Germany-based global support organisation. Funds teacher training programmes, social Waldorf initiatives and school development across Latin America including Brazil, Colombia, Peru and Mexico. freunde-waldorf.de/en/waldorf-worldwide/organisations-worldwide/latin-america

name: Weleda Latin America
bio: Weleda do Brasil (São Paulo) is the primary Weleda presence in Latin America. Anthroposophic medicines and skincare. Practitioner referrals available. weleda.com.br

name: IVAA Latin America Contact
bio: IVAA maintains contacts for all Latin American countries — Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Peru and Uruguay. Start at ivaa.info/about/our-members to find the national association or contact person for any country in the region.

name: Anthromedics — Latin America Research
bio: Der Merkurstab published a comprehensive overview: "Latin America: Open Windows for the Future" — the history of AM development across all Latin American countries with training, political and academic achievements. Available via anthromedics.org/DMS-21242-EN

name: Centre for Creative Education (CCE) — Training hub for all Africa
bio: Cape Town, South Africa. The most significant Waldorf teacher training institution in Africa. State-accredited degrees valid across South Africa and internationally recognised at Waldorf schools worldwide. Serves South Africa and East Africa. centreforcreativeeducation.co.za

name: East African Waldorf Teacher Development Programme
bio: Training hub for Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. 25+ years. Based at Rudolf Steiner School Mbagathi, Nairobi. Online resources: eawaldorf.com · online.eawaldorf.com

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst — Africa Programme
bio: Friends of Waldorf Education, Berlin. Main funder and coordinator for Waldorf development across Africa. Supports South Africa, East Africa and West African initiatives. freunde-waldorf.de/en/waldorf-worldwide/organisations-worldwide/africa

name: ⭐ CCE Cape Town — Teacher Training Manuals (Africa)
bio: Centre for Creative Education, Cape Town. The CCE has produced a series of open-source teacher training manuals specifically written for the East African Waldorf context — Child Development Based on the Insights of Rudolf Steiner — used in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Developed by Peter van

name: Southern African Federation of Waldorf Schools — Publications
bio: Cape Town, South Africa. The Federation has produced key curriculum guides for the South African context — including Curriculum: Waldorf Schools in South Africa (Peter van Alphen / Sally von Holdt, 2000) — the foundational South African Waldorf curriculum document used in schools, teacher t

name: Africa: A Teacher's Guide — Rudolf Steiner College Press
bio: USA/Africa. A carefully organised resource for teaching children and adolescents about African culture — songs, fairy tales, mythologies, biographies, art and recipes, divided by geographical region. Practical activities for each grade including kindergarten. Used in Waldorf schools worldwide for Af

name: CCE Sponsor a Kindergarten Teacher Project
bio: The cost to train one kindergarten teacher through the CCE is €3,000 — training one teacher enables 300 children per year to experience Waldorf-inspired education. freunde-waldorf.de/en/wow-day/projects-around-the-world/south-africa-centre-for-creative-education

name: All Africa Anthroposophic Training (biennial)
bio: Biennial gathering for anthroposophical training and community-building across Africa. Covers human development and social competence inspired by anthroposophy. Contact via Anthroposophical Society in South Africa or Freunde Waldorf Africa.

name: ⭐ Agriculture Course (GA 327) — Rudolf Steiner
bio: Spiritual-Scientific Foundations for Agricultural Renewal. The foundational text — eight lectures from Koberwitz, June 1924. Available as: hardback, paperback, and many translations. The indispensable primary text for any serious student of biodynamics. SteinerBooks · Floris Books · Rudolf Steiner P

name: The Biodynamic Sowing and Planting Calendar — Maria Thun (annual)
bio: Floris Books. Published annually. Maria Thun researched cosmic planting rhythms for 50+ years — this calendar gives daily root/flower/fruit/leaf day designations based on moon position. Used by biodynamic farmers and gardeners worldwide. The essential practical companion to Steiner's Agriculture Cou

name: Gardening for Life: The Biodynamic Way — Maria Thun
bio: Floris Books. The accessible introduction to biodynamic gardening practice for home gardeners and families. Maria Thun's decades of research made practical. Covers preparations, planting calendar, soil, composting. Perfect starting point.

name: Farming with the Cosmic Forces — Rudolf Steiner
bio: SteinerBooks. Selected lectures on biodynamic agriculture — a more accessible anthology than the full Agriculture Course for those new to biodynamics. SteinerBooks.

name: Soil and Soul — Alastair McIntosh
bio: Aurum Press. Not specifically biodynamic but widely read in biodynamic circles — land, community, spirituality and the deep connection between healthy farms and healthy communities. Deeply resonant with anthroposophical values.

name: ⭐ Annual Agriculture Conference — Goetheanum, Dornach, Switzerland
bio: Since the first Agricultural Conference in 1925, such a conference has taken place every year to the present day. name: ⭐ Biodynamic Association (USA) — Webinars, Courses & Annual Conference
bio: USA / Online. The Biodynamic Association offers webinars and courses exploring the wisdom and practice of Rudolf Steiner's indications for biodynamic agriculture and nutrition. Each month's lesson offers practical, experiential, and artistic exercises, alongside inner development exercises. Particip

name: ⭐ Threefold Community Farm — Practical Training in Biodynamics
bio: Chestnut Ridge, New York (Threefold Community — same campus as Sunbridge, Green Meadow Waldorf School, Eurythmy Spring Valley). In thirteen full-day workshops from September to June, this one-year part-time practical training covers the basic principles and timely activities of biodynamic agricultur

name: Pfeiffer Center Biodynamic Course — NOFA/Mass
bio: Massachusetts, USA (via NOFA/Mass). Named for Ehrenfried Pfeiffer — one of Steiner's closest agricultural collaborators. Annual series of one-day workshops September–April. Topics: The Individualised Farmscape and Pruning Fruit Trees · Seeing Nature Whole / Life Rhythms and Planting Calendar (with C

name: Josephine Porter Institute (JPI) — Applied Bio-Dynamics
bio: USA. Supporting gardeners and farmers in their practice of biodynamics since 1985. JPI provides biodynamic preparations, educational workshops, books, research and e-news updates. JPI publishes Applied Biodynamics quarterly. The primary North American source of biodynamic preparations for those who

name: Biodynamic Association — Farmer Foundation Year Programme
bio: USA. A full foundation year in biodynamic farming practice. Workshop participation credits can be accumulated through Pfeiffer Center workshops. Comprehensive introduction to all aspects of biodynamic farm management. biodynamics.com/farmer-foundation-year

name: Demeter Training — International
bio: Demeter International coordinates biodynamic training programmes across its 63 member countries. Each national Demeter organisation offers local training, certification workshops and farm visits. demeter.net/services/biodynamic-training — find training in your country.

name: Asian Biodynamic Training and Networking Conference (annual)
bio: Asia. Annual gathering for biodynamic practitioners in Asia — October 2024 conference. Growing biodynamic movement in India, Japan, South Korea, China and Southeast Asia. Contact via Demeter International for current Asia training resources.

name: Hawthorne Valley Farm — Workshops & Apprenticeships (USA)
bio: Ghent, New York (Hudson Valley). One of North America's most celebrated biodynamic farms — run alongside Hawthorne Valley Waldorf School and the Association for Cultural Evolution. Farm apprenticeships, workshops, community education. Open farm days. Products in CSA and local markets. hawthornevalle

name: Emerson College — Agriculture Programme (UK)
bio: Forest Row, East Sussex, England. The leading European centre for anthroposophical and biodynamic education — Emerson College offers courses in biodynamic agriculture, Goethean science, art, Waldorf education and social renewal. Founded 1962. One-year and shorter programmes. emerson.ac.uk

name: Skandinavisk Biodynamik / Biodynamic Federation Scandinavia
bio: Scandinavia. Training, workshops and farm network across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. Contact via Demeter International Nordic member organisations.

name: ⭐ The Biodynamic Sowing and Planting Calendar (annual) — Maria Thun
bio: Floris Books. Published every year — the practical calendar showing root, flower, fruit and leaf days based on lunar position. Even if you cannot do the full biodynamic preparations, gardening by this calendar is deeply rewarding and produces measurable improvements in plant vitality, flavour and ke

name: Turtle Tree Seed (USA)
bio: A small non-profit seed company. 100% open-pollinated vegetable, herb and flower seeds. Organic and biodynamic, grown in their own seed garden and by other farmers and gardeners — all non-GMO, non-hybrid, grown without chemical inputs. turtletreeseed.org

name: Josephine Porter Institute (JPI) — Preparations by Mail
bio: USA. JPI sells biodynamic preparations by mail for farmers and home gardeners who cannot make their own. The most accessible source of high-quality biodynamic preparations in North America. Also: books, quarterly newsletter Applied Biodynamics. jpibiodynamics.org

name: Holle — Demeter Baby Food
bio: Founded in Switzerland in 1934, Holle was the first Demeter-certified baby foods brand. Approximately 80% of their products worldwide carry the Demeter seal — the highest international standard for holistic, ecological and ethical farming practices. Available internationally. holleusa.com · holle.ch

name: Weleda — Biodynamic Medicinal Garden
bio: Weleda has maintained a biodynamic medicinal plant garden since 1921 — the same year the company was founded alongside the first Waldorf school. Their products use biodynamically grown medicinal plants. A direct living link between Waldorf education, anthroposophic medicine and biodynamic agricultur

name: ⭐ Foodwise: Understanding What We Eat and How It Affects Us — Wendy Cook
bio: Clairview Books (2nd revised edition 2012). THE definitive anthroposophical nutrition book. Wendy Cook studied macrobiotics and Steiner's approach to nutrition and biodynamic agriculture after her daughter developed asthma. She devoted herself to cooking and teaching in clinics, com

name: ⭐ The Biodynamic Food & Cookbook: Real Nutrition That Doesn't Cost the Earth — Wendy Cook
bio: Clairview Books. Wendy Cook takes us on a journey through the four seasons with more than 150 delicious recipes based on many years of working with biodynamic nutrition. Explains the principles behind biodynamic methods and places them in the context of food and cooking through the ages. Considers t

name: ⭐ Nutrition: Food, Health and Spiritual Development — Rudolf Steiner
bio: SteinerBooks (anthology, ed. Christian von Arnim). In this carefully collated anthology, Rudolf Steiner considers nutrition in the light of his anthroposophic spiritual-scientific research. He explains the impact of raw food, vegetarian, and meat diets; the effects of protein, fats, carbohydrates, a

name: The Dynamics of Nutrition — Gerhard Schmidt
bio: Biodynamic Literature. Gerhard Schmidt discusses vegetarian nutrition from an anthroposophical perspective in depth. Explores why plant-based nourishment cultivates inner forces that make us more capable of work and thought. One of the most thorough anthroposophical treatments of nutrition available

name: Cooking for the Love of the World — Anne-Marie Fryer Wiboltt
bio: Awaking Our Spirituality through Cooking. A deeply practical and spiritually grounded guide to cooking from an anthroposophical perspective. Covers the grain rhythm, seasonal cooking, preparing food with reverence and the relationship between food and spiritual development. Biodynamic ingredients, w

name: Nourishing Wisdom: A Mind-Body Approach to Nutrition and Well-Being — Marc David
bio: Harmony Books. Though not specifically Waldorf, widely recommended in anthroposophical nutrition circles for its exploration of the relationship between food, consciousness and emotional life — deeply resonant with Steiner's own indications. Explores how the state in which we eat is as important as

name: The Waldorf School Snack & Meal Book
bio: Various Waldorf school community publications. Several Waldorf schools have produced their own recipe books for school meals and snacks — often reflecting the grain rhythm, seasonal cooking and biodynamic principles. Check your nearest Waldorf school or AWSNA for school-produced cookbooks.

name: Simply in Season — Mary Beth Lind & Cathleen Hockman-Wert
bio: Herald Press. Not specifically anthroposophical but deeply aligned with Waldorf nutrition principles — recipes organised by season, locally sourced whole foods, whole grains throughout, biodynamic principles in spirit. Widely used in Waldorf family kitchens as a practical seasonal companion.

name: The Moosewood Cookbook — Mollie Katzen
bio: Ten Speed Press. The beloved whole food vegetarian cookbook that generations of Waldorf families have used as their kitchen bible. Not anthroposophical, but whole grains, seasonal vegetables and nourishing plant-based cooking throughout. Has been in Waldorf family kitchens worldwide since 1977.

name: Nourishing Traditions — Sally Fallon
bio: New Trends Publishing. Widely used in Waldorf and anthroposophical family circles — fermentation, traditional food preparation, bone broths, whole grains, raw dairy. Not specifically Steiner-based but deeply resonant with his indications on traditional and living food preparation. Particularly value

A curated international collection of Waldorf chalkboard drawings from teachers around the world — seasonal nature boards, festival boards, curr

name: @chalkdrawingsofwaldorf (Instagram)
bio: Instagram. A dedicated collection of Waldorf chalkboard drawings from teachers worldwide. Seasonal, curriculum-linked and celebratory boards. A community gathering place for Waldorf teacher-artists sharing their board work. Search alongside #waldorfchalkboard and #waldorfblackboard for the widest in

bio: USA. 5th Grade class teacher at Brooklyn Waldorf School. 26 years at Hawthorne Valley Waldorf School. BFA in Painting (Pratt Institute), Waldorf Teaching Certificate (Alkion Center). Teaches the annual summer workshop at Sunbridge Institute: <em>"Techniques and Skills for Creating Beautiful Drawings

name: waldorfteacherresources.com — Chalkboard Gallery
bio: USA / International (free). A teacher-contributed resource site with a dedicated Chalkboard Drawings gallery — main lesson boards from Grades 1–8, sorted by grade and subject. Contributions from Waldorf teachers worldwide. One of the most comprehensive free online chalkboard reference libraries. wal

name: Waldorf Inspirations — Chalkboard Idea Gallery
bio: USA (free). Janet Langley and team. The Waldorf Inspirations website includes a curated Pinterest boards gallery with samples of chalkboard drawings and main lesson book pages for many curriculum blocks — EC through Grade 8. Thousands of ideas. waldorfinspirations.com

name: Waldorf at Work — Meredith Floyd-Preston (Substack)
bio: USA. Experienced Waldorf class teacher and writer. Substack newsletter Waldorf at Work covering practical classroom art, chalkboard drawing tips, main lesson book titles, hand-lettering strategies and painting by grade. Honest, self-deprecating and deeply practical — written from the perspe

name: ⭐ Waldorfish — Robyn Beaufoy & Brian Wolfe (Australia)
bio: Australia. Trained Waldorf teachers with 25+ years in art and education. Online courses for homeschoolers and teachers: Waldorf Art for Beginners (includes chalk technique basics and a complete chalk landscape drawing lesson, plus DIY chalkboard instructions); Weekly Art Foundations

name: Gail Lescher BFA — Prairie Moon Chalkboard Video Workshops
bio: USA. Waldorf master teacher with BFA. Prairie Moon Waldorf School produced two landmark video workshops with Gail Lescher: Chalk Board Drawing Lesson (100-minute video, all skill levels) and Advanced Chalkboard Drawings (full-day workshop, 4+ hours video — techniques and a series o

name: Fairy Shadow (Etsy/Website)
bio: California, USA. Tania's Waldorf babies, mini critters and small handmade pieces. An unmistakable and much-loved personal style.

name: Sienna Academy

name: The Acorn and Oak

bio: Colorado USA (German-born). German-style Waldorf pocket dolls, blanket dolls and cuddle babies in the German Waldorf aesthetic. Cotton velour + natural sheep wool. Small home studio batches. Etsy: germandolls

name: 🇷🇴 Wood Pecker Factory — Romania

name: 🇺🇦 Waldorf World — Ukraine
bio: Dnipro. Needle-felted gnomes, fairies, fairy houses, animals, fruits, vegetables and birthday crowns. Real pine cones, moss, snail shells, beading. International shipping. Etsy: WaldorfWorld

name: 🇷🇺 Green Taiga — Russia
bio: Novosibirsk. Waldorf-inspired animals and trees from alder wood. Non-toxic paints, linseed oil and wax. Great character through carving. European and American shipping. Etsy: GreenTaiga

name: 🇦🇺 Niniani Creations — Australia
bio: NSW, Australia. Wet-felted play mats and wool felted gnomes and peg people with stunning magical headpieces. Local ethically farmed natural fibres. Free Australian shipping. Etsy: NinianiCreations

name: 🇦🇺 Deb's Steiner Dolls — Australia
bio: NSW, Australia. Full-size Waldorf and Steiner dolls and rainbow gnomes. Hand-dyed 100% wool coats stitched with hand-dyed cotton. Each one uniquely beautiful. Etsy: DebsSteinerDolls

name: 🇧🇪 @dollbelge ⭐ — Viktoriya Vashchenko (Belgium)
bio: Belgium. 215,000 followers. Viktoriya handcrafts organic Waldorf dolls from the Kingdom of Belgium. 11 years of making — 5 years building a global community. Organic cotton fabrics, natural wool, beeswax cheeks. Collaborates with Daniela Drescher (beloved Waldorf children's book ill

name: 🇧🇷 Evi Dolls — Women's Cooperative, São Paulo, Brazil ⭐

name: 🇵🇪 Q'ewar Project — Andahuaylillas, Peru ⭐
